title: RPL DIO/DAO rate limit (30 msg/min per source IID) not implemented
description: Spec 05-routing.md §8.4.5 (R-05-029): 'Receivers MUST rate-limit RPL control message (DIO/DAO) processing to at most 30 messages per minute per source IID. Messages exceeding this limit MAY be dropped before signature verification.' Evidence: no DIO/DAO per-source rate limiter exists in Rust (rust/lichen-node), C (lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl), or Python (python/src/lichen/rpl) — repo-wide search found only unrelated SOS/deaddrop/DIS limiters (C DIS limiter at lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/rpl_dis.c:133 is DIS-only). No test vector. Suggested placement: RPL stack ingest path — Rust rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/receive.rs, C lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/, Python python/src/lichen/rpl/. Spec text: https://github.com/ file spec/05-routing.md:295-299.
